4823-5289-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4823-5289-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2105-7175-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-7175-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-7175-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

4770-6006-6090-7297.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

955-5078-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
955-5078-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2178-2380-2511.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-2511.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

339-677-3899-4885.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1011-2292-2728-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2292-2728-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2292-2728-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

225-851-4094-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-851-4094-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

792-997-1263-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2590-4885-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

650-3175-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2440-4460-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-4460-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3459-3755-5078-5243.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2404-5478-6507-7115.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional lands.
2404-5478-6507-7115.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
2404-5478-6507-7115.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle and another land by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing a land that wasn't tapped for mana in step 1.
Toph's second ability triggers, earthbending Gaea's Cradle
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending another land you control.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing the land that was earthbent in step 6.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending Gaea's Cradle.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning the sacrificed land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land that entered by tapping it adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.
2404-5478-6507-7115.notes: If the other land that is recurred doesn't produce mana, you must control four or more creatures for the combo to function.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with one or more charge counters on it
with two or more film counters on it

2003-3609-6924.description:
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping it and removing a film counter from it, copying Contagion Engine's ability.
Resolve both Contagion Engine abilities, putting at least three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter and at least one film counter on Peter Parker's Camera.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat during your next turn.
2003-3609-6924.notes: If you start a turn with Magistrate's Scepter having four or more charge counters on it, you can skip steps 1 through 3 during that turn. This also allows you to save the mana for that turn.

1545-2034-3490-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-2034-3490-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

141-1269-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1269-2034.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

916-2073-4241.description:
Activate Vault of Whispers by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Vault of Whispers to become a creature until end of turn.
Vault of Whispers dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Vault of Whispers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-5220-6535-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

1669-3293-5531.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
You do not have any static effects boosting your creatures' toughness.
1669-3293-5531.description:
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
When you sacrifice the last land, Lumra will die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Lumra trigger from step 2, causing you to mill four cards and return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
1669-3293-5531.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2541-4017-6428.notablePrerequisites:
Magmakin Artillerist has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
2541-4017-6428.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-4124-5954-6751-6763.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

224-573-1772-3875.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1235-1617-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Twinflame.
1235-1617-4831-4983-5358.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1235-1617-4831-4983-5358.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

1429-5402-5686-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-5402-5686-5929.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

859-1424-3330.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
859-1424-3330.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2-1283-1651-1822.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value one or less.
2-1283-1651-1822.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value one or less and by tapping Ancestral Statue, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the noncreature artifact has a mana value of zero, this combo nets infinite mana, which would allow you to instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

uses.n: Ratchet, Field Medic // Ratchet, Rescue Racer

2873-3204-4659-5118.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least four life this turn.
2873-3204-4659-5118.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mysterious Limousine, adding {C}{C}.
Sludge Strider triggers, causing you to pay {1} to gain 1 life and cause an opponent to lose 1 life.
Ratchet, Field Medic triggers, converting it into Ratchet, Rescue Racer, and returning Mysterious Limousine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mysterious Limousine enters the battlefield, it and Sludge Strider trigger.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Ratchet until Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Sludge Strider trigger, choosing not to pay.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mysterious Limousine, adding {C}{C}.
When Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield, Ratchet returns to the battlefield from exile as Ratchet, Field Medic.
Repeat from step 2.

1734-2034-2506.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, choosing not to exile a creature.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter with haste.
The Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
The nontoken Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token, adding {C}{C}.
The Fiend Hunter token leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-2122-2445-4279.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Crystalline Crawler and Mindless Automaton have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
2060-2122-2445-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's second ability by paying {B}{B} and discarding a card, causing you to put two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler and Mindless Automaton.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

731-2385-4703-5026.notablePrerequisites:
Corrupted Conscience attached to Brallin.
You have at least seven cards in hand.
731-2385-4703-5026.description:
Cast Change of Fortune by paying {3}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying {R}{R}, creating a copy of Change of Fortune.
Resolve the copy of Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Resolve the original Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1494-3961-4353.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Towering Might has at least one indestructible counter on it.
1494-3961-4353.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Atraxa triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours and the remaining three +1/+1 counters on any creature(s) you control.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

224-2248-3257.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

4222-4306-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Nyx Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
You have more than three devotions of blue color.
4222-4306-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Nyx Lotus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, enchanting Nyx Lotus.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding mana of that color equal to your devotion of that color.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.
